text: Look at my new smartphone! It has an amazing camera and a really fast processor.
Wow, it looks great. But I still prefer using my laptop for schoolwork. It's easier to type on.
I agree. A laptop is better for writing essays and doing research. But a smartphone is more convenient for staying connected and taking photos.
They're good for reading e-books and watching videos, but they're not as versatile as a laptop or a smartphone.
